cause_quote: The introducing diff gated deep recall on `return !params.hasStrongLaneOneHit && hasRecallIntent(params.message);`, and its intent matcher contained only English and Spanish patterns.
user_saw: When a user asked in French about an earlier conversation and the initial lookup found no strong match, Active Memory skipped deep recall.
summary: The fix adds French recall-intent patterns that let questions about past conversations trigger deep recall while filtering out ordinary statements and future reminders.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and confirmed that escalate mode required a regex match from its first version, so French questions such as “Tu te souviens de ce qu’on a décidé pour le serveur ?” failed that gate from the start. The first-parent history of the matcher shows the fix as the first commit to add French recall patterns.
